definitions.gloss: playing a match, game (in board games)
definitions.explanation: A formal match or game between two players in board games such as Go, shogi, or chess. Emphasizes the competitive, face-to-face nature of the match.

examples.japanese: {今日|きょう}は{大事|だいじ}な{対局|たいきょく}がある。
examples.english: I have an important match today.

examples.japanese: {二人|ふたり}の{棋士|きし}が{将棋|しょうぎ}の{対局|たいきょく}を{始|はじ}めた。
examples.english: The two professional players began their shogi match.

examples.japanese: タイトル{戦|せん}の{対局|たいきょく}はネットで{生中継|なまちゅうけい}されていたので、{大勢|おおぜい}のファンが{見守|みまも}った。
examples.english: The title match was broadcast live on the internet, so many fans watched.

notes:
USAGE:
Used specifically for board games like {将棋|しょうぎ}, {囲碁|いご} (Go), and チェス. Not used for sports matches ({試合|しあい}) or card games. Carries a formal, serious tone associated with professional competition.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {対局|たいきょく}する (to play a match)
- {対局|たいきょく}{相手|あいて} (opponent in a match)
- {対局|たいきょく}{中|ちゅう} (during a match)
- {対局|たいきょく}{室|しつ} (match room)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {試合|しあい}: match, game — for sports and general competition
- {勝負|しょうぶ}: contest, showdown — emphasizes the win/lose outcome
